hook_text: Before a single pot goes on, the meal for a hundred people exists on one page, with every gram and every rand counted.
clip_script: The brief: feed one hundred flood-displaced people in a hall, babies to grandparents, balanced, no fridge, on gas, little water. Specifications are the numbers for the food: 2 100 kilocalories each, four groups every day, 400 grams of staple, 60 of protein, 25 of oil, soft food for the young and old, no pork. Constraints are the limits on the kitchen: R20 a head, two burners, 400 litres, two big pots, lunch by one. Now the meal: pap, pilchard and tomato relish, cabbage. Write it for ten. Multiply by ten. Twelve kilograms of meal, twenty tins, five cabbages. Does it fit the pots? Does it fit the hour? Cost it: R8.35 a plate, about R18 a day. Inside. Judge it on nutrition, flavour, texture. Then hand the page to a team mate and say: you are the cook, it is six in the morning. Go.
visual_style: Whiteboard one-page layout filling in: brief, two columns, recipe for ten, times-ten arrows, a cost table summing, three criteria ticked.
mood: Organised and warm, planning to feed people well.
pacing: Brief, specs, constraints, meal, scale, cost, judge, handover, each a beat.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plan a meal for one hundred on one page.
